body.zh-Hant: 東條英機1884年12月30日生於東京，父親是陸軍軍人東條英教。他1905年3月從陸軍士官學校（第17期）畢業，1919年8月起駐在瑞士，1921年7月起駐在德國。1935年9月，他出任關東憲兵隊司令官兼關東局警務部長。
body.en: Tojo Hideki was born in Tokyo on 30 December 1884, the son of the army officer Tojo Hidenori. He graduated from the Army Academy (17th class) in March 1905, was stationed in Switzerland from August 1919 and in Germany from July 1921, and in September 1935 became commander of the Kwantung Gendarmerie and head of the Kwantung Bureau police affairs department.

heading.zh-Hant: 關東軍參謀長到陸軍大臣
heading.en: From Kwantung Army chief of staff to army minister

body.zh-Hant: 1937年3月，東條出任關東軍參謀長，1938年5月任陸軍次官，因辦事幹練被稱為「剃刀東條」。1938年12月起兼任航空總監與航空本部長。1940年7月起，他在第2次、第3次近衛內閣擔任陸軍大臣，同月兼任對滿事務局總裁。
body.en: In March 1937 Tojo became chief of staff of the Kwantung Army and in May 1938 vice-minister of the army, where his efficiency earned him the nickname "Razor Tojo". From December 1938 he was inspector general of aviation and head of the Aviation Headquarters. From July 1940 he served as army minister in the second and third Konoe cabinets and, in the same month, as head of the Manchurian Affairs Bureau.

heading.zh-Hant: 首相兼陸相與戰時體制
heading.en: Prime minister and army minister in wartime

body.zh-Hant: 1941年10月18日東條內閣成立，東條以首相兼任陸軍大臣與內務大臣，內相兼任到1942年2月。戶部良一指出，現役軍人兼任首相與陸相，是1885年內閣制度開始以來的首例。1942年9月1日起他短暫兼任外務大臣，同月17日由谷正之接任。1942年舉行翼贊選舉，議會趨於形骸化；1943年11月兼任軍需大臣，1944年2月又兼任參謀總長。
body.en: Tojo's cabinet was formed on 18 October 1941, with Tojo serving as prime minister while also army minister and, until February 1942, home minister. Tobe Ryōichi notes that an officer on active duty serving as both prime minister and army minister was unprecedented since the cabinet system began in 1885. From 1 September 1942 he briefly doubled as foreign minister until Tani Masayuki took over on 17 September. A Diet election was held in 1942 under a candidate-recommendation system, hollowing out the Diet; in November 1943 he also became munitions minister and in February 1944 chief of the army general staff.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年7月，東條內閣總辭，同月他轉入預備役。日本戰敗後，他企圖自殺但失敗，之後在遠東國際軍事審判中被以甲級戰犯判處絞刑，1948年12月23日去世。
body.en: In July 1944 the Tojo cabinet resigned and Tojo was placed on the reserve list the same month. After Japan's defeat he attempted suicide but failed, was tried by the International Military Tribunal for the Far East as a Class A war criminal and sentenced to hang, and died on 23 December 1948.

body.en: Chiang Chung-cheng was born in Fenghua, Zhejiang, in 1887. As a young man he went to Japan to study military affairs and graduated from the Shinbu Gakko. When the 1911 revolution broke out he returned to China without taking leave and then assisted Chen Qimei in the revolution.

heading.en: Whampoa, the Northern Expedition and the chairmanship

body.zh-Hant: 國史館小傳記載，蔣中正1924年擔任黃埔陸軍軍官學校校長。1926年7月，他就任國民革命軍總司令，發動北伐。1928年中國完成統一，同年年底他就任國民政府主席。
body.en: According to the Academia Historica biography, Chiang became commandant of the Whampoa Military Academy in 1924. China was unified in 1928, and at the end of that year he became chairman of the National Government.

body.zh-Hant: 據行政院歷任院長表，蔣中正多次出任行政院院長：民國19年11月24日至20年6月16日、20年6月16日至12月16日、24年12月16日至27年1月1日、28年12月11日至32年9月13日，以及32年9月13日至34年6月4日（即1930年至1945年間的五段任期）。1938年4月1日，中國國民黨臨時全國代表大會恢復領袖制度，推舉他擔任總裁。
body.en: According to the Executive Yuan's list of past premiers, Chiang served several times as Premier of the Executive Yuan: from 24 November 1930 (ROC 19) to 16 June 1931, from 16 June to 16 December 1931, from 16 December 1935 to 1 January 1938, from 11 December 1939 to 13 September 1943, and from 13 September 1943 to 4 June 1945. On 1 April 1938 the Kuomintang's Provisional National Congress restored the leader system and elected him Director-General (zongcai).

body.zh-Hant: 列寧原姓烏里揚諾夫，1870年4月22日（舊曆10日）生於辛比爾斯克，出身視學官家庭。1887年他以金質獎章從辛比爾斯克中學畢業，進入喀山大學，三個月後因參與學潮被開除；同年其兄亞歷山大因籌劃刺殺沙皇亞歷山大三世被處絞，對他影響很大。1891年他以外部生身分修畢彼得堡大學法學系。
body.en: Lenin, born Vladimir Ulyanov, was born in Simbirsk on 22 April (10 April old style) 1870 into the family of a schools inspector. In 1887 he finished the Simbirsk gymnasium with a gold medal and entered Kazan University, but was expelled after three months for taking part in student disturbances; that year his elder brother Alexander was hanged for plotting to kill Tsar Alexander III, which greatly influenced him. In 1891 he completed the law faculty of St Petersburg University as an external student.

heading.zh-Hant: 組黨、流亡與布爾什維克
heading.en: Party building, exile and the Bolsheviks

body.zh-Hant: 1895年，列寧與後來的孟什維克領袖馬爾托夫創立「工人階級解放鬥爭協會」；因政治鼓動入獄兩年，又被流放西伯利亞三年。1900年他在西歐流亡中參與創辦《火星報》。1903年俄國社會民主工黨在倫敦召開第二次代表大會，他貫徹了自己的建黨構想，黨隨之分裂為他領導的布爾什維克與孟什維克。1912年他使布爾什維克作為獨立政黨與社會民主黨最終分離。
body.en: In 1895 Lenin and Julius Martov, later the Menshevik leader, founded the League of Struggle for the Emancipation of the Working Class; for political agitation he spent two years in prison and three years in Siberian exile. In 1900, in exile in western Europe, he helped found the newspaper Iskra. At the second congress of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party in London in 1903 he pushed through his party concept, and the party split into the Bolsheviks he led and the Mensheviks. In 1912 he finally separated the Bolsheviks as an independent party from social democracy.

heading.en: The October Revolution and the chairmanship of Sovnarkom

body.zh-Hant: 1917年春列寧回到俄國，4月提出《四月提綱》，主張立即媾和、土地改革與蘇維埃政府。10月25日（新曆11月7日）彼得格勒發生起義，布爾什維克奪取政權；當晚第二屆全俄蘇維埃代表大會宣布成立蘇維埃政府人民委員會議，列寧任主席。1918年，在他倡議下與德國簽訂了布列斯特和約。
body.en: Lenin returned to Russia in spring 1917 and in April set out the April Theses, demanding immediate peace, a sweeping land reform and a soviet government. On 25 October (7 November) 1917 an uprising in Petrograd brought the Bolsheviks to power; at the evening session the Second All-Russian Congress of Soviets proclaimed the Soviet government, the Council of People's Commissars, with Lenin as its chairman. In 1918, on his initiative, the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk was concluded with Germany.

heading.zh-Hant: 新經濟政策、病重與逝世
heading.en: The New Economic Policy, illness and death

body.zh-Hant: 1921年起列寧推行新經濟政策，准許私人自由貿易。1922年5月與12月他兩度中風，仍繼續領導國家；1923年3月第三次中風，使他幾乎喪失工作能力。1924年1月21日他在莫斯科近郊的哥爾基逝世。
body.en: From 1921 Lenin introduced the New Economic Policy, which allowed free private trade. He suffered two strokes, in May and December 1922, but continued to lead the state; a third stroke in March 1923 left him practically incapacitated. He died at Gorki near Moscow on 21 January 1924.
